facts.fact: 复活后的 Lucy 给自己定的目标：接下来八周做个可靠的姐姐。
facts.anchor: Being a reliable sister to Jess is my primary goal for the next eight weeks.

facts.fact: 她出门穿的是闪亮粉色牛仔靴，平时只在特殊场合穿。
facts.anchor: I tug on the sequined pink cowgirl boots I usually only wear on special occasions before leaving my apartment.

facts.fact: 她去的咖啡店叫 Leviathan’s，周日早上店里没有排队。
facts.anchor: Leviathan’s is usually packed on weekday mornings, but today is Sunday.

facts.fact: 咖啡师叫 Katie，几乎每天都接她的单。
facts.anchor: Katie, the barista who takes my drink order almost every day, is wiping nonexistent crumbs off the counter as I approach.

facts.fact: 等咖啡时她在心里排练昨晚编好的那个谎。
facts.anchor: As Katie makes my drink, I mentally rehearse the lie about last night that I came up with on my way here.

facts.fact: 她杯中的奶泡显出的是一副骷髅加交叉骨。
facts.anchor: Two crossed bones beneath a sightless skull.

facts.fact: Jess 和 Lucy 曾因猫 Wilfred 偷吃家藏巧克力送急诊，那晚的值班兽医就是 Liam。
facts.anchor: They met one night when Jess and I had to rush Wilfred to the emergency pet hospital after he got into our secret chocolate stash. Liam was the vet on duty.

facts.fact: Daniel 说要传给她的那项能力，她身上本来就已经有了。
